breakpoints.note: After `jsmn_parse` succeeds on the one-byte buffer, top-level dispatch recognizes `tokens[0].type == JSMN_PRIMITIVE` and enters `parse_primitive` instead of rejecting the input as partial JSON.

First project parser statement that materializes vulnerability-relevant state from the attacker-controlled JSON bytes: the primitive token boundaries later reconstructed as the numeric slice parsed by `parse_primitive`.

The staged patch fixes this site by copying at most `str_end - str_val` bytes into `cbuf`, appending `\0`, calling `strtoll(cbuf, &endp, 10)`, and translating `endp` back to the original slice; it also switches the floating-point path from `atof(str_val)` to `atof(cbuf)`.
